title: Short run observation
statement: One supplied-device run attempted 1000 entries and saw 987 acknowledgments after two disconnected hours; no restart or recovered-ID count was tested.

title: Long restart pair
statement: Two preview 0.8 trials attempted 400 actions each after 36 disconnected hours; sign-in blocked application start and both recorded zero acknowledgments.

title: Six-hour restart accounting
statement: One six-hour restart trial acknowledged 398 of 400 attempts; a manual recovered export contained 390 event IDs; accounting for eight acknowledged IDs remains unresolved.

title: Method and independence limit
statement: The fictional vendor supplied the devices and preview build for all runs; these authored lab-style notes are not an independent certification.
